targets.title: “A” Business by Any Other Name: Firm Name Choice as a Signal of Firm Quality
targets.evidence_quote: The claim selected for replication from McDevitt (2014) is that those with names that begin with an A or a number receive more than five times as many complaints with the Better Business Bureau.
targets.outcome_quote: Thus the replication claim was successful according to the SCORE criteria.
